scope: One fresh disposable Kind v1.36.1 cluster, the published adjacent case's Istio 1.32.0 sidecar runtime, two case-owned Python fixture Pods, and one additional inert Pod with a per-Pod injection opt-out label in the injection-enabled runner namespace. The opt-out Pod sends no requests. Compares a small finite set of local GETs before and after applying documented Envoy proxy CPU/memory annotations to the backend. Reads the injected istio-proxy request/limit values from the Pod spec and checks bounded authenticated request availability. A server-side dry-run of a candidate whose proxy CPU request exceeds its limit exercises the admission rollback guard without mutating the known-good Pod. Throughput, GPU behavior, mTLS overhead, and production availability remain unverified. A case-local native ValidatingAdmissionPolicy also requires a complete synthetic MeshExemption record for this exact inert opt-out Pod; its reviewer and risk-owner values are test metadata, not verified identities. The record's expired state is checked, but wall-clock expiry, approval authority, and effectiveness of production compensating controls are not.

checks.claim: Pinned Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind control plane
Istio control plane is ready from the pinned release
The default proxy serves three exact authenticated fixture requests

Tuned backend retains three of three exact local GET responses
Over-budget candidate is rejected and the exact known-good proxy and 3/3 connectivity remain in service
The documented per-Pod opt-out omits the proxy only on its inert Pod while the tuned mTLS route stays active
Native admission requires a complete scoped exception record for only the inert sidecar opt-out Pod
